freightDispatchDiagnosis.scope: Active local snapshot, before marketing-department and user authorization filtering; not live FOP totals
diagnosis: Native cost, currency, confirmation date, weight and unit already in supplied queryDispatch DTS.
Decimal normalizer discards fractional JSON numbers. Rebuild from precision-preserving raw data using decimal strings.
Dispatch mappings must use hzkj_bizoperator, hzkj_sale_org, hzkj_basedatafield, hzkj_logistics_channel1 and entryentity.
Legacy NORMAL-only gate excludes historical blank interception states. Cost recognition must not be inferred from fulfillment state.
Dashboard remains Mock; current fixed USD contract requires documented FX or replacement with original-currency aggregation.
proposedRules: Use company + dispatch ID, latest modification; aggregate header cost once regardless of SKU rows.

Use approved documents with positive confirmed actual cost and known currency, grouped by UTC+8 freight confirmation date. Cancellation/interception separately flagged; do not silently erase incurred cost. Final eligibility policy remains pending implementation.
Normalize RMB to CNY, KG/Kg to kg, g to kg by /1000; missing currency/unit remains unknown.
Cost per kg uses sum of costs divided by sum of kg for the same eligible weight-known sample; report excluded count.
No cross-document joins needed for baseline freight analysis once native ownership is returned. SKU cost allocation, profit and transport duration need separate allocation/revenue/events evidence.
Reuse local chart cache: daily 09:00-18:00 UTC+8 30min, other hours 2h, manual query forces local refresh; never starts FOP collection.
